description: Wave-6 render-path-unification proof: hydratePortableDoc works in the REAL consuming-app surface, not just the isolated media-parity helper. A neuter island copy (hydratePortableDoc call removed) stays inert, so the proof goes red on revert. Browser mode is the DEFAULT `test` script so it GATES under turbo/CI.
